source_span: Here we describe an additional pathway for regulation of F-box proteins on the example of yeast Met30 . This ubiquitylation and degradation pathway acts on Met30 that is dissociated from Skp1 . Unexpectedly , this pathway required the cullin component Cdc53/Cul1 but was independent of the other central SCF component Skp1 . The experiments with skp1 single and skp1 cdc53 double mutants strongly suggested that the ‘Skp1-free’ degradation pathway for Met30 was dependent on Cdc53 and independent of Skp1 Unexpectedly , Cdc53 was indispensable for Met30ΔFbox degradation , because inactivation of the temperature sensitive cdc53-1 allele blocked degradation ( Fig 2B ) .
